name: yuhi-code
displayName: Yuhi Code — See What Your AI Agent Sees
description: Prepare your workspace before Claude Code sees it. One Privacy Mode across Static Prepare, Dynamic Terminal, and Native Claude GUI — transform direct personal identifiers, redact secrets, and keep the session isolated from your normal VS Code environment.

enumDescriptions: Recommended for most repositories.
More conservative handling for business repositories.
Shares the minimum context allowed by current Yuhi policies.
yuhi.safetyMode.description: Safety Mode preset applied when Yuhi prepares this workspace. Changing it takes effect the next time you prepare (re-prepare) the workspace.

enumDescriptions: Inherit yuhi.yaml's privacy.mode, or Balanced if unset.
Direct personal identifiers are transformed. Operational identifiers are preserved. Detected secrets are redacted from the prepared workspace.
Direct personal identifiers are transformed. Operational identifiers are preserved. Detected secrets are redacted. Unverified artifacts remain local-only.
Privacy transformation is disabled: personal identifiers are delivered unchanged. Requires confirmation on first use.
yuhi.privacyMode.description: What happens to direct personal identifiers when Yuhi prepares this workspace (a DIFFERENT axis from Safety Mode). Empty inherits yuhi.yaml's privacy.mode.

yuhi.compress.description: Compress source structure (drop implementation bodies, keep signatures) to reduce tokens.

enumDescriptions: Do not create compact context representations.
Automatically create safe compact representations when useful (recommended).
Always enable safe compression; use the optional best-effort Token Budget.
yuhi.compressionMode.description: How Yuhi prepares compact repository context. Auto is recommended; failed compression always falls back to the full file.

yuhi.permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission mode used in Yuhi Mode. Yuhi does not disable Auto mode globally.

enumDescriptions: Use Claude Code defaults; Yuhi adds no permission restrictions.
Enable Claude's sandbox while preserving Auto mode and prompting for unsandboxed commands.
Apply Yuhi's strict sandbox restrictions; Auto or bypass capabilities may be limited.
yuhi.sandboxPreset.description: Runtime sandbox preset. Repository preparation and Safe Apply remain enforced independently.

yuhi.tokenBudget.description: Target token budget for the prepared context. Enable Context Compression first. Use 0 for No target; positive whole numbers are best-effort targets.

yuhi.alwaysIncludeWarningExtensions.description: File extensions explicitly allowed with inspection warnings. Known credentials and policy blocks still remain excluded.

yuhi.alwaysExcludeExtensions.description: File extensions explicitly kept out of the Prepared Workspace.

yuhi.dynamicContext.retrievalMode.description: Retrieval capability shown to the agent during a dynamic context session. Measured: registering the retrieval tools adds ~507 tokens to every request and costs extra agent turns, so the default is disabled. Originals stay privately stored and retrievable in every mode.

enumDescriptions: Developer Mode: project configuration, including .env, may be read by Claude Code. Raw values are never written to Yuhi logs, evidence or UI.

Strict Mode: masks detected secrets and supported identifiers before delivery (the 0.3.x behaviour). Detection coverage depends on file format and content — it is not a guarantee that every secret or identifier is removed.
yuhi.dynamicContext.deliveryMode.description: LEGACY, superseded by yuhi.dynamicContext.privacyMode: how detected secrets are handled during a dynamic context session. Ignored once privacyMode is set.

enumDescriptions: Inherit the mode the prepared run used, or Balanced if unknown.
Direct personal identifiers are transformed. Development secrets may be delivered to Claude when required, but are not written to Yuhi logs or evidence.
Direct personal identifiers and detected secrets are both transformed before delivery.
Personal identifiers and development secrets may be delivered unchanged. Requires confirmation; use only with a trusted local model or private infrastructure.
yuhi.dynamicContext.privacyMode.description: What happens to direct personal identifiers (and, composed with this, detected secrets) during a dynamic context session. Supersedes yuhi.dynamicContext.deliveryMode. Empty inherits the prepared run's own recorded mode.

enumDescriptions: v0.4 behaviour: no task-aware planning at all.
The Planner computes and records a task-aware delivery plan for every tool result, but never changes what is actually delivered. Recommended until a benchmark justifies Active as the default.
The Planner's plan drives delivery for reuse, structured, reference and window representations. Not yet the default pending measured evidence -- see docs/design/0.5.0_benchmark.md.
yuhi.dynamicContext.generationMode.description: v0.5.0 Task-Aware Dynamic Context Generation mode for a dynamic context session. Advanced setting -- not shown during first run.

yuhi.dynamicContext.contextBudget.description: v0.5.0 best-effort per-session token target for the Planner. null (default): no target, identical to pre-0.5.0 behaviour. Advanced setting -- not shown during first run.

yuhi.dynamicContext.contextMaximum.description: v0.5.0 hard per-session token ceiling for the Planner. null (default): no ceiling, identical to pre-0.5.0 behaviour. Advanced setting -- not shown during first run.

yuhi.nativeSession.description: Set by Yuhi inside its own isolated Native GUI profile. Do not set this by hand; it identifies the session this window belongs to and carries no credential.

yuhi.nativeGui.extensionRef.description: Advanced. Which Yuhi build the isolated Native GUI window installs: a marketplace id, an id@version, or an absolute path to a .vsix. Leave empty to pin the running version. Set this to a local .vsix to try a build that is not published yet.
